name: InfoDeepSeek
description: InfoDeepSeek is a benchmark designed to evaluate agentic information seeking in retrieval-augmented generation systems within dynamic, real-world web environments. It features challenging queries and a novel evaluation framework with fine-grained metrics assessing accuracy, utility, and compactness of information seeking outcomes.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with emerging interest in agentic RAG and web information-seeking, but it has not yet seen broad community adoption.
notes: First evaluation framework tailored for dynamic agentic information seeking; includes metrics beyond static gold document sets.
